name: english-buddy
description: Silent English coach for non-native speakers: catches typos, grammar, and awkward phrasing in your English prompts, forwards clean English to the model, tracks error-rate trends, and provides today/stats/mistakes/drill/review/preview/config workflows.
suggestedPrompts: Show my English Buddy report for today
Show my English Buddy stats and error-rate trend
Give me an English Buddy drill on my recurring mistakes
